📺 Grey’s Anatomy (2005–Present)

Grey’s Anatomy follows Meredith Grey, a talented young doctor who begins her medical career as a surgical intern at Seattle Grace Hospital. Alongside her fellow doctors, Meredith faces intense medical emergencies, complicated surgeries, and difficult decisions that test both her professional abilities and personal relationships. As the years pass, friendships develop, romances unfold, and unexpected tragedies change the lives of everyone working at the hospital. From heartbreaking patient stories to unforgettable moments of courage and compassion, the doctors must balance their demanding careers with love, family, and personal struggles. With emotional storytelling, memorable characters, and dramatic twists, Grey’s Anatomy explores friendship, sacrifice, resilience, and the extraordinary challenges of saving lives.

🎭 Genre: Medical Drama • Romance • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.6/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 42 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creator: Shonda Rhimes

📺 Where to Watch: Hulu and Netflix in the United States. Availability varies by region.
